summary: Mark the expanded thread that thread keys act on, and list thread keys in help

replay.detail: Rendering only; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread key bindings, selection and access rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Clients and daemons interoperate as before.

manual.detail: Expand two threads in an agent pane: the selected thread draws a ▌ gutter on the selected-row background, like the Inbox list, and the gutter stays visible with NO_COLOR and while its composer is focused. Press ? to see the new threads section: click ▸ ▾, t, p, z, n, v, r, esc and ctrl+r.
